opening.argument: The segment is presented as an ABC15 Investigators report on gift-card texts, not as an offer to its viewers. It identifies the reported text as a scam unrelated to Walmart and relays a warning that the associated website may ask for private, credit-card, or Social Security information. The report separately describes a customer-service survey opportunity requiring a receipt number and says it requires no personal information. It directs viewers to ABC15 consumer alerts for more on scams. These distinctions make the gift-card messages the subject of a consumer warning, not a reward the segment is asking viewers to claim.

citations.quote: the ABC15 Investigators found the gift card text is a scam that has nothing to do with Walmart.
